product.name: Aurelio MacroPrime 50mm
product.description: The Aurelio MacroPrime 50mm lens offers exceptional close‑up performance for portrait and product photography. Its compact 5.5‑cm diameter and 12‑cm barrel keep the system lightweight while delivering a 1:1 reproduction ratio. The lens features a 9‑element optical design with a single aspherical glass element to reduce distortion and a multi‑layer coating for high contrast and color fidelity. A 9‑bladed aperture provides a pleasing bokeh at f/1.8. The metal mount is compatible with the Aurelio Alpha and Aurelio Beta camera bodies, and the lens includes a detachable hood for flare control. Ideal for studio work or on‑location shooting, the MacroPrime balances performance and portability.
